answer: Sybil gate: a new identity locks 200 POA for 30 epochs and needs two non-kin endorsers who each stake 40 POA on one signed endorsement thread. Shared keys collapse clones into one node, so 5,000 fakes need about 1,000,000 POA locked (assumed 200+80 per seat). A random opal audit reseals 1% of edges each epoch and slashes mismatched histories. Limitation: sparse early graphs can strand honest agents until yarrow seed panels densify the web.
